name: IPRATROPIUM 20 MCG AEROSOL FOR INHALATION 200 DOSE 1 PIECE
description: Ipratropium bromide 20 mcg inhalation spray with 200 doses is used as a bronchodilator in the maintenance treatment of chronic bronchospasm, primarily in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). It helps relax the airway muscles to facilitate breathing. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
